evals.name: charter-and-timebox
evals.prompt: Explore the new undo command for 20 minutes.
evals.expected_output: Writes a one-line charter, explores within the time and turns each finding into a reproducible note. Does NOT extend the session indefinitely.

evals.name: never-changes-acceptance
evals.prompt: Exploration found an odd message on an edge case.
evals.expected_output: Files it as a separate bug. Never adds it to the PR acceptance.
